Surprisingly, it’s not actually changing size. It’s an optical illusion created by your brain! 🧠 When the Moon is near buildings, trees, and the horizon, your brain compares it to objects on Earth, making it appear larger. High in the sky, with nothing to compare it to, it suddenly looks smaller. Same Moon. Same size.
